episodes.175029: A surface low pressure system developed along the southeast Texas Coast on the afternoon of November 14th. This low tracked east along the northern Gulf Coast that afternoon and through the overnight hours, early morning hours November 15th. A warm front appendant to east side of this low became to focus of severe thunderstorms across all the local coastal waters.
episodes.175845: The combination of a low-level trough from the east and an upper-level trough produced scattered to locally numerous showers and thunderstorms across eastern Puerto Rico on November 15th.  The doppler radar estimated up to 6 inches of rain in Yabucoa.
